title: To acknowledge the Black Women Best framework to empower and improve life for all through guaranteed income, expanding child and income tax credit, increasing access to equitable health care and government assistance, prohibiting policing in schools, and prioritizing restorative justice.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
policyArea: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
summary: This resolution supports the need for and use of certain policy frameworks to incorporate the experiences of Black women into public policies.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
